notes: Slot L comes in jet motion across the formation and takes the handoff at full speed on the edge. Authored playside-right like every other symmetric run in the catalog; the engine mirrors it at runtime (`OffensivePlayInstance.mirror`), which is also what turns the motion around -- Slot L and Slot R swap names on the reflection, so the motion man is always the backside slot. Aligned at Boundary Right rather than Pocket, which is what makes this a true Sweep to `RunPlayState.isSweepPlay` and gets it the CB-fulcrum Sweep Read Phase (run_play_loop.md Section 12) instead of Zone Stretch's off-tackle read. No target_gap for the same reason as i_formation_toss and power_i_toss: the Sweep Read Phase sets the runner's Line of Scrimmage entry dynamically once the corner's block status resolves, so a static target would be overwritten. Z stalks the playside corner -- he is the fulcrum that read is posed against. He carries `motion: true` -- the Motion Velocity Bonus (run_play_loop.md Section 3) is his, and this is the play the section names. His `starting_zone` is authored at his near-snap position, already carried to the play side, which is what Section 3 says to do with a motion player.
